glazuli.configuration.title: Glazuli Settings
glazuli.scenes.title: Menu Scene
glazuli.scenes.hint: Run /menuscene save <name> in a world to save your current spot as a scene
glazuli.scene.saved: Saved scene "%s" and set it as the menu background
glazuli.configuration.enableGlass.toolti: When off, panels use a plain translucent background.
glazuli.configuration.blurQuality.toolti: How much the glass blurs what's behind it. Higher costs more GPU.
glazuli.configuration.enableRefraction.t: Panel edges bend the picture behind them, like real glass.
glazuli.configuration.introMode.tooltip: When to replace the loading screen with the Glazuli intro. OFF leaves it alone.
glazuli.configuration.styleReloadOverlay: Show the Mojang screen and exit animation when you change resource packs or language, or press F3+T.
glazuli.configuration.startupSound.toolt: Plays when you first reach the title screen; menu music starts after it. To use your own, put a startup.ogg in config/glazuli.
glazuli.configuration.classicUi.tooltip: Use the vanilla look and font on the title screen, keeping only the animated background. The button in the top-right corner of the title screen does the same.
glazuli.configuration.inGameUi.tooltip: The style of the pause menu, inventories, chat and so on once you're in a world. You can also switch with the icon button in the pause menu.
Glazuli's own title screen, with an entrance animation.
glazuli.configuration.caveBackground.too: Replace the panorama with a 3D scene. The camera moves as you switch menus and when you join a world.
glazuli.configuration.scene.tooltip: The scene behind the menus. You can also pick one with the Scenes button on the title screen. For scenes saved with /menuscene save <name>, enter custom:<name>.
glazuli.configuration.realTimeLighting.t: Outdoor scenes follow your computer's clock. When off, each scene stays at its own time of day.
glazuli.configuration.shaderScene.toolti: With a shader pack loaded, the menu scene is drawn through it too, costing about as much GPU time as a world. Turn off on slower graphics cards for Glazuli's own, much lighter lighting. Scenes with block entities (beds, chests, machines) still use the world renderer.
glazuli.configuration.glassInventory.too: Your inventory, the hotbar and containers like chests and furnaces use liquid glass. Modded containers only change if they use vanilla colors.
glazuli.configuration.customFont.tooltip: Use HarmonyOS Sans instead of the pixel font, or PingFang if your system has it. Font files in config/glazuli/fonts are used first.
With Sodium installed, its video settings use liquid glass too.
glazuli.configuration.glassJei.tooltip: JEI's panels, buttons and search field use liquid glass.
rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.horizontal: Use the left and right arrow keys to scroll
rso.narration.scrollbar.usage.vertical: Use the up and down arrow keys to scroll
